Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — dashboards and reports | 缺项 | P2

## Triage: first grade — `enhancement` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:reports` · `pm:queue`. "Refresh All" joins the filter bar's row, and the report view drops its fixed tall minimum

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-06T06:58Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Re-read on objectui `main` (`c3623eb116`): live, and not a duplicate of objectui#11674–#11690.

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx` (the refresh button as its own `col-span-full` grid item, about `:1335`–`:1336` and `:1434`) and `packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.tsx` (`min-h-150`, about `:427`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the button takes a full grid row with at least 80 px plus the gap, and the report view forces about 600 px.

- **Correction to the card:** the report half is not `LegacyReportRenderer`, which draws only pre-spec `{data, columns}` reports. It is `ReportView.tsx`'s `min-h-150`.
- **Done when:** the refresh control shares the filter bar's row, or the header's, and a report's height follows its content within the page.
- **Pin:** the first screen of the measured dashboard shows its first widget row without scrolling at 1440×900.

## Review: ACCEPT — PR objectui#11737 (head `56995c1`) · the dev's open question ruled **A** by this seat

`domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01DrKzdPdyLLBW3qpZ4vtk7z` · reviewed against the PR diff and check runs, read 2026-10-06T17:05Z. Report: `os-dev-report` on this card.

### The ruling: console dashboards with no filter bar

**A — the refresh control keeps a button-high row of its own there.** B (a host placement seam) and C (the renderer draws the console header) are not taken.

- **Why the seat rules instead of escalating:** existing norms decide it.
  - The pm-dispatch decision framework says a new public surface with no measured pull defaults to no.
  - The card's pin is measured as met in every case. In the PR body's real-layout reading at 1440×900, the Chart Gallery first chart row ends at y=886 on screen.
- **Four-axis reasoning:**
  - **Long term:** A keeps one placement rule (filter row, else the renderer's header row, else a button-high row of its own). B adds a second placement path that the auto-refresh timer and the refreshing indicator would have to follow. C reverses the console's chrome split.
  - **Business need:** what remains is about 52px on dashboards with no filter bar, and no user or card asks for it.
  - **Guarding against AI-authored mistakes:** B's public prop would be reachable from metadata, because SchemaRenderer forwards unknown keys as props.
  - **Startup focus:** A adds zero surface.
- **What this changes on the card:** triage's "shares the filter bar's row, or the header's" is met wherever a header the renderer draws exists. On the one remaining layout the control's own row shrinks from a 5rem row to the button's height. Under this ruling the card is complete: the seat switches the PR's first line from `Part of` to the closing form, and records the ruling in the PR body's "Open question" section.
- If the maintainer wants B, that is a new card for the `Clause-②: yes` seam, and it does not reopen this one.

### Review

- **Shape:** draft → `main`; `Clause-②: no` at line start.
- **PR assignee: not set.** The dev's `label-write --assign` was refused by its session's permission classifier. The seat does not re-issue it; this is raised with the maintainer.
- **Scope:** 5 files, all inside the claim's surface: `DashboardRenderer.tsx`, `ReportView.tsx`, one pin each, and one changeset. +387/−84; most of the −84 is re-indentation of the unchanged header block. Nothing under `content/docs/releases/`.
- **Clause-② re-read on the diff:** layout and class changes only. No export, prop, type member or locale key changes ⇒ `no` holds.
- **Mechanism checked on the diff:**
  - `refreshControl` (the badge and the button) is placed in the filter row when filters exist, and in the renderer header row when there are none (`refreshInHeader`), otherwise in its own row.
  - The positioned grid's full-width rows get explicit `auto` tracks, so the filter row no longer takes the `minmax(5rem, auto)` floor. The dev measured this as a second floored row that H1 had missed; the correction is accepted.
  - `ReportView`'s card loses `min-h-150`. The comment in the diff gives the reason nothing inside needs it: loading and not-found return earlier, and the chart has a fixed height.
- **Changeset** (`plugin-dashboard` patch, `app-shell` patch). Sentences checked against the diff:
  - "It now sits at the right end of the filter bar's row": matches.
  - "…without filters it sits at the right of the dashboard's own header when the dashboard draws one, and otherwise stands alone in a row only as tall as the button": matches the ruled A.
  - "The header and the filter bar row no longer take that minimum": matches.
  - "The card is now as tall as the report": matches.
- **Tests:** 6 new pins (5 dashboard, 1 report). Reverting both source files to base turned 5 red, and the negative control stayed green by design; the restore was proven by the blob hash. Local `plugin-dashboard` suite: 173 files. `app-shell` full suite at `fea4eb0`, plus the 14 targeted files at `56995c1` (declared narrowing; CI runs the farm). The real-layout before/after is in the PR body.
- **CI at `56995c1`:** 42 runs, still converging (15 `in_progress` at this read); no completed run is red. Enqueue waits for every check to be green.
- **Out-of-scope findings:**
  - The record-count badge's word "records" is a hard-coded English literal. This PR moves it but does not create it. It is the objectui#11689 family (hard-coded English words in display chrome), so it is **carried there** in a comment, not a new card.
  - `plugin-dashboard` ships no stylesheet, so a consumer must scan its source for the new arbitrary utilities: Acceptance notes. The console scans it.
